description: A sprite sheet of SIXTEEN separate small crop plants arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows, each centered in its own cell, growth stages from left to right (1 sprout, 2 young, 3 growing, 4 ripe ready to harvest). Row 1 grape: tiny sprout, small vine on a short wooden trellis, leafy vine on trellis, trellis vine with purple grape bunches. Row 2 chili pepper: tiny sprout, small pepper plant, bushy pepper plant with white flowers, bushy plant with red chili peppers. Row 3 tea: tiny sprout, small tea shrub, round tea bush, lush round tea bush with fresh light green tips. Row 4 sunflower: tiny sprout, small sunflower stem, tall stem with a green bud, tall sunflower with a big yellow bloom. Each plant upright on a tiny dark soil mound, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, natural colors, every plant fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no field, no shadow, no text, no numbers
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
